customers.discount) AS \"orders.net\"\n  FROM orders AS orders\n  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers\n    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id\n  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions\n    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id\n  WHERE\n    NOT customers.id IS NULL\n  GROUP BY\n    customers__regions.name,\n    customers.tier\n)\nSELECT\n  _base.\"orders.customers.regions.name\",\n  _base.\"orders.customers.tier\",\n  _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum.\"orders.net\",\n  _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum_partition_by_customers_regions_name.\"orders.region_net\",\n  _base.\"orders.n\"\nFROM _base\nLEFT JOIN _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum_partition_by_customers_regions_name\n  ON _base.\"orders.customers.regions.name\" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum_partition_by_customers_regions_name.\"orders.customers.regions.name\"\nLEFT JOIN _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum\n  ON _base.\"orders.customers.regions.name\" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum.\"orders.customers.regions.name\"\n  AND _base.\"orders.customers.tier\" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum.\"orders.customers.tier\"\nORDER BY\n  _base.\"orders.customers.regions.name\" ASC,\n  _base.\"orders.customers.tier\" ASC\nLIMIT 101"

args.message: The table has 13 rows, one for each region and customer tier. Each row shows the net total for that group and the net total for its whole region. For each order, the net amount is the order amount minus the ordering customer's discount, and these are added up. Orders whose customer ID doesn't match any customer record were left out. Customers with no known region are grouped under a null region; that group has only silver-tier customers, with 10 orders and a net total of 627.83.
